title: campanula glomerata subsp. oblongifolioides
intro: Campanula glomerata subsp. oblongifolioides, commonly known as the clustered bellflower, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the bellflower family (Campanulaceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in relieving digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Campanula glomerata subsp. oblongifolioides include its ability to reduce pain and swelling, as well as its potential to act as an antiseptic and antibacterial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
